summary.intent: Land a CI concurrency change (cancel in-progress runs on new PR pushes) via a trail, test it with a second push, and merge it; then add a uv `exclude-newer = "3 days"` setting to pyproject.toml.
summary.outcome: PR #168 (ARS-74) was verified to cancel the first CI run on a second push, then merged to main with ARS-74 marked Done. The uv exclude-newer change (ARS-75) was committed and pushed on a branch with a temporary ruff exemption, but no trail or PR has been opened yet.

repo: CI runs on Depot CI (`.depot/workflows/ci.yml`); workflow-level `concurrency` with group `ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}` and `cancel-in-progress: true` works, and a cancelled run does not leave a stuck red check on the PR.

Work follows a ticket-first flow: Linear issue (ARS-nn), branch `chore/ARS-nn-...`, then an Entire trail linked from the PR body, and `entire trail merge <id>` after the user approves (gates: head matches, no open findings, checks pass).
CI pins uv 0.13.5 while local uv is 0.13.6; the lockfile should be generated and checked with both (`uvx --from uv==0.13.5 uv lock`).
`exclude-newer = "3 days"` is stored in uv.lock as the span `P3D`, so the lock stays stable across days.
Exact-pinned `ruff==0.17.3` was published 27 Oct 2026, so the 3-day cutoff made the lock unsatisfiable; a temporary `exclude-newer-package = { ruff = "2026-10-28T00:00:00Z" }` exemption was needed.

The cutoff downgraded platformdirs, python-discovery and virtualenv by a patch each, and it also affects Renovate lockfile maintenance and `uv lock --upgrade`. It matches Renovate's 3-day minimumReleaseAge.
AGENTS.md has a dev-tools line about `uv add`; a note was added there about the cutoff and how to exempt a package.

code.finding: `[tool.uv]` now has `exclude-newer = "3 days"` plus a commented temporary `exclude-newer-package` exemption for ruff, to be removed after 30 Oct 2026.

workflow: Scripted a delayed second push in a background shell script with logs to test CI cancellation, then checked results via `gh pr checks` and `depot ci run list --status cancelled`.
Test config changes in a scratch copy of the project rather than the working tree, and be careful with cleanup commands there.
Use `</dev/null` on gh/git/entire commands to avoid interactive hangs, and retry pushes in a short loop.

friction: `uv lock` failed with the plain `exclude-newer` because of the exactly pinned, very new ruff, requiring a user decision and a temporary exemption.
Ran `git checkout pyproject.toml` after scratch testing, which wiped the assistant's own branch edit; it had to be re-applied.
The first trail-linking step needed a manual PR body edit to embed the trail link after the trail was created.
The Entire trail URL was inconsistent: the transcript used trail IDs 109 and 249 for the same trail.
open_items: Remove the ruff `exclude-newer-package` exemption after 30 Oct 2026; nothing automated will remind anyone.
Open a trail and PR for ARS-75 (branch `chore/ARS-75-uv-exclude-newer`, commit 1a081651); the user was asked but has not answered.
The firmware host test suite was not rerun for the uv change.
The empty test commit 91f1b2cd remains in main history; squashing would need a force push.
